method: Read complete controller and fixed development plan; inspected already-approved parent v11 control metadata and current source/runtime/partial-hand Opus approval metadata only.

Isolated temporary Git repository supplies synthetic ledger, registration, audits, models and three tasks. Public runner/generator imports replaced with explicit fixture stubs; child spawn replaced with throwing mock. Actual controller prepare/validate and failing run guards exercised only in that fixture.
Fixture original source SHA binds exact reviewed controller; strict standalone TypeScript compile includes ignored controller with noUncheckedIndexedAccess.
No real ledger, auth, provider, live claim, held/model outcome or new-registration access; no real controller or report builder execution.

limitations: Engineering admission only; review is not an inference dispatch, reservation, affordability invoice, native result, accepted calibration or insurance-expert validity.
Forecasts may understate actual usage. Existing authoritative ledger is checked at actual preparation and every remaining dispatch; this reviewer did not read it.
Three correlated anchors per condition give 33.33-point macro steps and cannot localize a 50–60 frontier target. Only high-effort tier comparison is prospective.
Opus review independently hands only phase1 of one task, with partial later-phase reasoning. Full non-author source/runtime audit is distinct; no full-hand coverage claim.

Cumulative truncation does not erase configured raw observations, but bars a clean paired tier comparison. Provider/model/process/material-cost failures pause dispatch; prior incomplete coverage prevents next serial dispatch.
Current review exact-byte binding becomes stale on any controller change; registration/freeze/native audits remain separate mandatory gates.
Fixture corpus and source modules are deliberately stubbed; semantic case/gold correctness is provided by separate non-author source audit, not these controller tests.
